paragraph:
# Velmoria's living memory

*Forty years on, the republic resists the urge to (idolatrize) its own founders*

LET THIS chapter not (eulogize) too freely. Forty years after the marshal fell, Velmoria faces a temptation more insidious than tyranny: the urge to (lionize) its founders into something fossilised and false. A free people who (idolatrize) their own heroes are only one step from kneeling again, and the republic has begun, with characteristic (verve), to (scrutinize) the very legend that sustains it.

The danger does not (faze) the wiser heads. They know that to (homogenize) the past into a single (motif)—plucky republicans against a cartoon villain—is to (bowdlerize) it, to (sterilize) the (bracing) complexity that makes history (instructive). They refuse to (generalize) the founders into saints or to (characterize) the marshal as a mere (dwarf) of evil. To (capitalize) on a tidy myth would (demoralize) the very civic instinct the founders worked to (vitalize).

So the republic has set out to (revitalize) memory rather than (fossilize) it. The state archive, once a place to (conserve) records in (stiff) silence, now invites citizens to (scrutinize) the documents themselves—to test the official story, to seek its (disproof) as readily as its (proof), to (publicize) what earlier governments preferred to (reserve). The aim is to (sensitize) the public to nuance, not to (sermonize) at them or (proselytize) a creed.

Recall, by contrast, how the marshal handled the past. He sought to (monopolize) memory entirely—to (raze) inconvenient archives, to (pulverize) dissent, to (vaporize) the names of those he had wronged. His ministry would (plagiarize) the achievements of better men and (aggrandize) his own. He longed to (colonize) the future as well, to (amortize) his cult across generations so that no (reproof) could ever (materialize). He would (ostracize) the honest, (stigmatize) the brave, and (cauterize) every wound to power before it could fester into resistance.

The republic does the (converse). It declines to (penalize) the historian who questions, or to (antagonize) the critic who (satirize)s its sacred days. When a young scholar published a book that dared to (particularize) the founders' failings—their early blunders, their (tiff)s and compromises, the corners they (carve)d off principle to survive—the state did not move to (ostracize) her. It put her on the syllabus. To (externalize) the debate, rather than (internalize) it as shame, was the whole point.

There are, inevitably, those who would (polarize) the question for gain. A populist (windbag), all (bluff) and (brag), tours the provinces to (demoralize) the young and (sermonize) about decline. He is a (prig) and a self-appointed (plaintiff) in every imagined grievance, forever ready to (temporize), to (extemporize) a new outrage, to (capitalize) on every (lag) in the public mood. He would gladly (decentralize) nothing and (monopolize) everything. But the republic does not (paralyze) itself with fear of him. It lets him (quaff) his fill of attention, then watches the public (doff) their interest and move on. His (chaff) finds no (maize) to mix with.

Beyond the politics, the country has never looked so (entrancing). Where the marshal left (slag) heaps and salted earth, engineers now (desalinize) the coastal flats and (fertilize) the reclaimed fields, and farmers (specialize) in crops the old regime never let them grow. A (chef) in the revived capital makes a (motif) of local (foodstuff); dairies (pasteurize) and (homogenize) their milk to honest standards; a single (ewe) grazes the green (crag) above a village that once knew only (grief). The economy does not (gormandize) on debt; it grows to (maximize) the common good, its gains broad rather than hoarded as (pelf).

Institutions, too, have matured. Authority has been made to (decentralize): a provincial (sheriff) answers to local courts, not a distant throne. Officials are (deputize)d by law, scrutinised by a free press, and made to (utilize) public money openly. No one may (oxidize) into a fixture, clinging to office until the system rusts. The constitution has been amended—schematised afresh, you might say, the founders having learned not to (schematize) it once and forget it—to (conserve) liberty without letting it (fossilize) into dogma.

It would be easy, at forty years' remove, to grow complacent—to let the old (nerve) slacken, the watchfulness (lag), the (flag) of vigilance droop. The republic guards against exactly this. It teaches the young not to (idolatrize) the dead but to (emulate) their habits: to question, to (scrutinize), to refuse the comfortable lie. A sprig of remembrance is planted each spring—a literal (sprig) of cypress by the old prison wall—but no one is asked to (squeeze) tears from it or to wear mourning like a permanent (scarf).

So Velmoria, four decades free, neither (eulogize)s its past nor (satirize)s it into meaninglessness. The marshal sought to (monopolize) the nation's story and to (idolatrize) himself; his country has chosen the harder, (bracing) alternative—to keep its memory honest, its founders human, and its freedom a thing to (conserve) by daily effort rather than (fossilize) behind glass. A free people, the lesson runs, must always be willing to (carve) away their own myths, lest the (frieze) of national glory harden into a tomb.
translation:
韦尔莫利亚的活记忆

*四十年后，这个共和国抵御着把自己的建国者（奉若神明/idolatrize）的冲动*

让这一章不要太轻易地（歌功颂德/eulogize)。元帅倒台四十年后，韦尔莫利亚面临一个比暴政更隐伏的诱惑：把它的建国者（捧成偶像/lionize）成某种僵化而虚假之物的冲动。一群把自己的英雄（奉若神明/idolatrize）的自由人民，离再度下跪只有一步之遥，而这个共和国已经以其特有的（激情活力/verve)，开始去（仔细审视/scrutinize）那个支撑着它的传奇本身。

这危险并不（使……慌乱/faze）那些更明智的头脑。他们知道，把过往（同质化/homogenize）成一个单一的（主题母题/motif)——勇敢的共和派对抗一个漫画式的恶棍——便是把它（删改净化/bowdlerize)、便是（消毒去除/sterilize）那种使历史（发人深省/instructive)、（令人振奋的/bracing）复杂性。他们拒绝把建国者（笼统概括/generalize）成圣徒、或把元帅（描述刻画/characterize）成仅仅一个邪恶的（侏儒/dwarf)。靠一个整洁的神话来（牟利捞取/capitalize)，会（使……士气低落/demoralize）建国者们曾努力去（赋予活力/vitalize）的那种公民本能本身。

于是这个共和国着手去（重振激活/revitalize）记忆，而非把它（化石僵化/fossilize)。国家档案馆，曾经是一个在（僵硬/stiff）的沉默中（保存/conserve）记录的地方，如今邀请公民们亲自去（仔细审视/scrutinize）那些文件——去检验官方的说法、去像寻求其（证实/proof）一样欣然寻求其（反证/disproof)、去（公之于众/publicize）从前历届政府宁愿（保留隐藏/reserve）的东西。其目的是使公众对细微之处（变得敏锐/sensitize)，而非向他们（说教/sermonize）或（兜售改宗/proselytize）一套信条。

相比之下，回想元帅当年是如何对待过往的。他力图把记忆整个（垄断独占/monopolize)——（夷平/raze）碍事的档案、（碾碎/pulverize）异见、（蒸发抹除/vaporize）那些被他冤枉之人的名字。他的部门会（剽窃/plagiarize）比他更好之人的成就、并（吹捧抬高/aggrandize）他自己。他还渴望（殖民侵占/colonize）未来、把他的个人崇拜（摊销分摊/amortize）到一代代人身上，好让任何（责备/reproof）都永远无法（成真显现/materialize)。他会（排斥放逐/ostracize）诚实者、（污名化/stigmatize）勇敢者、并在每一道伤口溃烂成抵抗之前就将它对权力（烧灼封闭/cauterize)。

这个共和国做的是（相反/converse）的事。它拒绝（惩罚/penalize）提出质疑的史学家、或（敌视开罪/antagonize）那个（讽刺/satirize）它神圣纪念日的批评者。当一位年轻学者出版了一本胆敢（详述具体列举/particularize）建国者种种缺失的书——他们早年的失误、他们的（小争吵/tiff）与妥协、他们为了生存而从原则上（削去/carve）的那些角——这个国家没有出手（排斥放逐/ostracize）她。它把她编入了教学大纲。把这场辩论（外化/externalize)、而非作为羞耻把它（内化/internalize)，正是要旨所在。

不可避免地，有那么一些人会为了私利而把这个问题（极化对立/polarize)。一个民粹（吹牛皮的人/windbag)，满是（虚张声势/bluff）和（自夸/brag)，巡游各省去（使……士气低落/demoralize）年轻人、并就衰落（说教/sermonize)。他是个（道貌岸然的伪善者/prig)、是每一桩臆想冤情里自封的（原告/plaintiff)，永远随时准备（拖延敷衍/temporize)、（即兴编造/extemporize）一桩新的义愤、（趁机利用/capitalize）公众情绪中的每一处（滞后/lag)。他巴不得什么都不（下放分权/decentralize)、什么都（垄断独占/monopolize)。但这个共和国不因惧怕他而（使……瘫痪/paralyze）自己。它让他（痛饮/quaff）个够本的关注，然后看着公众（脱下抛却/doff）他们的兴趣、继续前行。他那（谷壳/chaff)，找不到能与之掺和的（玉米/maize)。

政治之外，这个国家从未显得如此（引人入胜/entrancing)。元帅当年留下（矿渣/slag）堆和盐碱化土地的地方，工程师们如今为沿海滩涂（脱盐淡化/desalinize)、为复垦的田地（施肥/fertilize)，农夫们（专门种植/specialize）旧政权从不让他们种的作物。复兴的首都里，一位（厨师/chef）把本地（食材/foodstuff）做成一个（主题母题/motif)；乳品厂按诚实的标准为牛奶（巴氏消毒/pasteurize）并（均质化/homogenize)；一只（母羊/ewe）在一座曾经只知（悲伤/grief）的村庄上方那青翠的（峭壁/crag）上吃草。这个经济不靠债务（大吃大喝/gormandize)；它增长是为了（最大化/maximize）公共利益，其收益广泛分布，而非作为（不义之财/pelf）被囤积。

种种制度也已成熟。权力已被弄得（下放分散/decentralize)：一位省级（治安官/sheriff）对地方法庭负责，而非对一个遥远的王座负责。官员们依法被（授予职权/deputize)、受自由新闻界审视、并被要求公开地（使用/utilize）公帑。没有人可以（氧化锈固/oxidize）成一件固定陈设、赖在官位上不走直到整个系统生锈。宪法已被修订——你或许可以说，被重新图解过了，因为建国者们已经懂得，不可把它一次性（图解定型/schematize）便忘到脑后——好（保全/conserve）自由，却不让它（化石僵化/fossilize）成教条。

在四十年之遥的距离上，要变得自满本是容易的——任凭旧日的（神经勇气/nerve）松弛、任凭警觉（滞后松懈/lag)、任凭那面警惕的（旗帜/flag）低垂。这个共和国正是要防范这一点。它教导年轻人不要把死者（奉若神明/idolatrize)，而要（效仿/emulate）他们的习性：去质疑、去（仔细审视/scrutinize)、去拒绝那个令人安适的谎言。每年春天会栽下一枝纪念之物——旧监狱墙边一枝真切的柏树（小枝/sprig）——但没有人被要求从它身上（挤/squeeze）出眼泪、或像一条永久的（围巾/scarf）那样披着哀悼。

于是韦尔莫利亚，自由了四十载，既不（歌功颂德/eulogize）它的过往，也不把它（讽刺/satirize）成毫无意义。元帅曾力图（垄断独占/monopolize）这个国家的故事、并把自己（奉若神明/idolatrize)；他的国家选择了那个更艰难、（令人振奋的/bracing）的替代之路——让它的记忆保持诚实、让它的建国者保持有血有肉、让它的自由成为一件靠日复一日的努力去（保全/conserve）、而非（化石僵化/fossilize）在玻璃之后的东西。这教训说道：一个自由的民族，必须永远愿意（削去/carve）他们自己的种种神话，免得那道民族荣光的（雕带饰纹/frieze）硬化成一座坟墓。

quiz.question: carve _ ______
quiz.explanation: 雕刻, 雕刻雕像. The sculptor spent months trying to carve a statue from marble. 雕塑家花了数月时间试图从大理石中雕刻一座雕像。 || 文化联想：中国玉雕工匠把一整块玉石慢慢雕成人物或瑞兽，最适合帮助记忆 carve，可以说 **carve a figure — “A jade craftsman may spend weeks carving a small figure from a single piece of stone.”**

quiz.question: ____ ___'_ nerve
quiz.explanation: 神经, 失去勇气. The climber began to lose one's nerve halfway up the cliff. 登山者在半山腰开始失去勇气。 || 文化联想：中文“临阵退缩”最适合帮助记忆 nerve，可以说 **lose one’s nerve — “A performer who was confident backstage but suddenly became afraid before going onstage may lose his nerve at the last moment.”**

quiz.question: ____ reserve
quiz.explanation: 储备, 现金储备. The company maintained a healthy cash reserve for emergencies. 公司为紧急情况维持了健康的现金储备。 || 文化联想：中国家庭常留一笔“应急钱”防止突然失业或生病，最适合帮助记忆 reserve，可以说 **an emergency cash reserve — “A family may keep an emergency cash reserve to cover several months of expenses if income suddenly stops.”**

quiz.question: conserve ______
quiz.explanation: 保存, 节约能源. We must conserve energy to reduce our carbon footprint. 我们必须节约能源以减少碳足迹。 || 文化联想：“随手关灯、节约用电”是中国家庭很熟悉的节能习惯，最适合帮助记忆 conserve，可以说 **conserve energy — “Turning off unused lights and appliances helps a household conserve energy.”**

quiz.question: ________ verve
quiz.explanation: 热情, 艺术热情. The painter approached each canvas with artistic verve. 画家以艺术热情对待每一幅画布。 || 文化联想：舞狮表演那种鼓点强劲、动作利落、满场有劲的感觉很适合联想到 verve，可以说 **perform with verve — “A lion-dance troupe can perform with verve as drums, cymbals, and acrobatics fill the street with energy.”**

quiz.question: ewe ____
quiz.explanation: 母羊, 母羊和羔羊. The shepherd watched over the ewe lamb in the meadow. 牧羊人在草地上照看母羊和羔羊。 || 文化联想：内蒙古草原上母羊带着小羊吃草的画面最适合帮助记忆 ewe，可以说 **a ewe and her lamb — “On the Inner Mongolian grasslands, a ewe may graze beside her lamb while the flock moves slowly across the pasture.”**

quiz.question: faze ___
quiz.explanation: 使困扰, 使他困扰. The criticism didn't faze him in the slightest. 批评丝毫没有使他困扰。 || 文化联想：中文“泰山崩于前而色不变”最适合帮助记忆 faze，可以说 **nothing can faze him — “A person who remains calm even if ‘Mount Tai collapses before him’ seems almost impossible to faze.”**

quiz.question: raze _ ________
quiz.explanation: 夷平, 夷平建筑物. Developers plan to raze a building to make room for new construction. 开发商计划夷平一栋建筑物以腾出空间进行新建设。 || 文化联想：旧城改造时整栋危房被推平重建，是 raze 最直观的中国城市场景，可以说 **raze an unsafe building — “A dangerously unstable building may be razed before a safer structure is built on the site.”**

quiz.question: squeeze ____
quiz.explanation: 挤压, 挤压管子. She had to squeeze tube to get the last bit of toothpaste. 她不得不挤压管子以获得最后一点牙膏。 || 文化联想：小时候挤最后一点牙膏出来，是中国家庭里很熟悉的 squeeze 场景，可以说 **squeeze the tube — “When the toothpaste is nearly gone, someone may squeeze the tube from the bottom to get the last bit out.”**

quiz.question: _____ frieze
quiz.explanation: 饰带, 石雕饰带. The ancient temple featured an elaborate stone frieze. 古代寺庙有精美的石雕饰带。 || 文化联想：敦煌石窟墙面上连续排列的横向装饰图案很适合帮助记忆 frieze，可以说 **a decorative frieze — “A cave wall may contain a decorative frieze of repeated floral or geometric motifs running in a horizontal band.”**

quiz.question: ______ maize
quiz.explanation: 玉米, 黄玉米. Farmers harvested fields of golden yellow maize. 农民收获了金黄色的玉米田。 || 文化联想：中国东北和华北大片玉米地最适合帮助记忆 maize，可以说 **yellow maize — “In autumn, fields of yellow maize can stretch across the countryside of northern China.”**

quiz.question: ostracize _ ______
quiz.explanation: 排斥, 排斥成员. The group voted to ostracize a member who violated their rules. 该团体投票决定排斥违反规则的成员。 || 文化联想：中文“把人排挤出圈子”最适合帮助记忆 ostracize，可以说 **ostracize a member — “A clan or social group that deliberately stops inviting one person may ostracize that member from the community.”**

quiz.question: publicize ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 宣传, 宣传活动. The organizers used social media to publicize the event. 组织者使用社交媒体来宣传活动。 || 文化联想：庙会、展览或社区活动前通过公众号和海报宣传，是 publicize 最熟悉的场景，可以说 **publicize an event — “Organizers may use posters and social media to publicize a local temple fair before the holiday.”**

quiz.question: oxidize _______
quiz.explanation: 氧化, 快速氧化. Iron will oxidize rapidly when exposed to moisture. 铁暴露在潮湿环境中会快速氧化。 || 文化联想：铁锅长期受潮后生锈，就是氧化最直观的生活场景，最适合联想到 oxidize，可以说 **iron oxidizes — “If a cast-iron wok is left wet, the iron can oxidize and form rust.”**

quiz.question: gormandize __
quiz.explanation: 狼吞虎咽, 狼吞虎咽地吃. The guests continued to gormandize on the lavish buffet. 客人们继续狼吞虎咽地吃着丰盛的自助餐。 || 文化联想：《水浒传》里好汉大碗喝酒、大块吃肉的豪饮豪食场面很适合联想到 gormandize，可以说 **gormandize on a feast — “At a lively inn, the heroes of Water Margin are often imagined gormandizing on meat and wine.”**

quiz.question: aggrandize _____
quiz.explanation: 扩大, 扩大权力. The dictator sought to aggrandize power at every opportunity. 独裁者试图在每一个机会扩大权力。 || 文化联想：古代权臣不断把军权、财权和人事权抓到自己手中，最适合帮助记忆 aggrandize，可以说 **aggrandize one’s power — “A powerful court minister may try to aggrandize his power by taking control of more offices and appointments.”**

quiz.question: eulogize ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 称赞, 称赞逝者. Friends gathered to eulogize the dead at the memorial service. 朋友们聚集在追悼会上称赞逝者。 || 文化联想：传统祭文和悼词会赞颂逝者一生的品德和功绩，最适合帮助记忆 eulogize，可以说 **eulogize the deceased — “At a memorial ceremony, a speaker may eulogize the deceased by recalling the person’s character and contributions.”**

quiz.question: specialize __
quiz.explanation: 专门从事, 专门从事于. The law firm decided to specialize in corporate litigation. 这家律师事务所决定专门从事公司诉讼。 || 文化联想：景德镇有工匠专门做拉坯、上釉或烧窑，最适合帮助记忆 specialize，可以说 **specialize in glazing — “A Jingdezhen artisan may specialize in glazing while other craftsmen focus on shaping or firing the porcelain.”**

quiz.question: materialize _____
quiz.explanation: 实现, 实现梦想. Hard work helped materialize dream of owning a business. 努力工作帮助实现了拥有企业的梦想。 || 文化联想：中文“梦想成真”最适合帮助记忆 materialize，可以说 **a dream materializes — “After years of saving and hard work, a family’s dream of opening its own shop may finally materialize.”**

quiz.question: penalize _ ____
quiz.explanation: 惩罚, 惩罚球队. The referee decided to penalize a team for unsportsmanlike conduct. 裁判决定因不当行为惩罚球队。 || 文化联想：足球比赛里球员犯规后被判黄牌或点球，是 penalize 最直观的体育场景，可以说 **penalize a team — “A referee may penalize a team for a serious foul by awarding the opponent a free kick or penalty.”**

quiz.question: externalize _____
quiz.explanation: 外部化, 外部化成本. Companies often try to externalize costs onto society. 公司经常试图将成本外部化给社会。 || 文化联想：工厂把污染排到河里、却让社会承担治理成本，是 externalize 最典型的经济学场景，可以说 **externalize environmental costs — “A factory that pollutes a river without paying for cleanup is trying to externalize environmental costs onto the public.”**

quiz.question: generalize ____

quiz.explanation: 严厉的, 严厉的惩罚. The judge imposed a stiff penalty for the serious offense. 法官对严重罪行施加了严厉的惩罚。 || 文化联想：中文“重罚”最适合帮助记忆 stiff，可以说 **a stiff penalty — “A serious violation may bring a stiff penalty designed to deter others from doing the same thing.”**

quiz.question: doff ___'_ ___
quiz.explanation: 脱下, 脱下帽子. Gentlemen would doff one's hat when greeting a lady. 绅士在问候女士时会脱下帽子。 || 文化联想：近代民国礼仪里男士摘帽致意的画面很适合联想到 doff，可以说 **doff one’s hat — “In an old Shanghai street scene, a gentleman might doff his hat when greeting someone politely.”**

quiz.question: bluff ____
quiz.explanation: 虚张声势, 要求摊牌. The poker player decided to bluff call on a weak hand. 扑克玩家决定用弱牌虚张声势要求摊牌。 || 文化联想：《三国演义》“空城计”最适合帮助记忆 bluff，可以说 **call a bluff — “Sima Yi chose not to call Zhuge Liang’s bluff at the empty city because he feared an ambush.”**

quiz.question: ______ foodstuff
quiz.explanation: 食品, 主食. Rice is a staple foodstuff in many Asian countries. 大米是许多亚洲国家的主食。 || 文化联想：中国人日常最熟悉的主食之一就是大米，最适合帮助记忆 foodstuff，可以说 **a staple foodstuff — “Rice is a staple foodstuff in much of southern China and appears at countless everyday meals.”**

quiz.question: _________ motif
quiz.explanation: 主题, 反复出现的主题. The novel featured a recurring motif of water and rebirth. 小说以水和重生为反复出现的主题。 || 文化联想：祥云纹在瓷器、服饰和建筑装饰中反复出现，最适合帮助记忆 motif，可以说 **a recurring motif — “The cloud pattern is a recurring motif in Chinese decorative art, appearing on ceramics, textiles, and architecture.”**

quiz.question: ___-______ pelf
quiz.explanation: 不义之财, 不义之财. The corrupt official amassed ill-gotten pelf through bribes. 腐败官员通过贿赂积累了不义之财。 || 文化联想：中文“不义之财”几乎就是 pelf 最直接的联想，可以说 **ill-gotten pelf — “A corrupt official who grows rich through bribes has accumulated ill-gotten pelf rather than honest wealth.”**

quiz.question: _____ reproof
quiz.explanation: 责备, 严厉的责备. The teacher delivered a stern reproof for the student's behavior. 老师因学生的行为给予了严厉的责备。 || 文化联想：私塾先生拿戒尺严厉训斥不认真读书的学生，最适合联想到 reproof，可以说 **a stern reproof — “An old-style schoolmaster might give a lazy pupil a stern reproof for repeatedly neglecting lessons.”**

quiz.question: _______ disproof
quiz.explanation: 反证, 逻辑反证. The scientist provided logical disproof of the hypothesis. 科学家提供了该假设的逻辑反证。 || 文化联想：中文“反证法”最适合帮助记忆 disproof，可以说 **a logical disproof — “In a mathematics class, a contradiction can provide a logical disproof showing that an assumption cannot be true.”**

quiz.question: ____ scarf
quiz.explanation: 围巾, 丝绸围巾. She wrapped a luxurious silk scarf around her neck. 她在脖子上围了一条奢华的丝绸围巾。 || 文化联想：苏州丝绸做成的围巾最适合帮助记忆 scarf，可以说 **a silk scarf — “A visitor to Suzhou may buy a soft silk scarf decorated with traditional floral patterns.”**

quiz.question: ______ dwarf
quiz.explanation: 矮人, 花园矮人. A colorful garden dwarf stood among the flowers. 一个色彩鲜艳的花园矮人站在花丛中。 || 文化联想：中国古代宫廷和杂技记载中也出现过身材异常矮小的艺人，可谨慎用来帮助记忆 dwarf，可以说 **a dwarf performer — “Historical courts sometimes included a dwarf performer whose unusually short stature made him stand out among entertainers.”**

quiz.question: ____-______ windbag
quiz.explanation: 夸夸其谈的人, 长篇大论的夸夸其谈者. The long-winded windbag monopolized the entire meeting. 这个长篇大论的夸夸其谈者垄断了整个会议。 || 文化联想：中文“夸夸其谈、废话连篇”最适合帮助记忆 windbag，可以说 **a long-winded windbag — “A speaker who talks for an hour without saying anything useful may be dismissed as a long-winded windbag.”**

quiz.question: fag ___
quiz.explanation: 末端, 末端. They arrived at the fag end of the performance. 他们在演出的末端到达。 || 文化联想：春节联欢晚会临近零点、节目快结束的最后一小段，可以帮助记忆 fag，可以说 **the fag end of the show — “Someone who switches on the Spring Festival Gala just before midnight may catch only the fag end of the show.”**

quiz.question: ___ lag
quiz.explanation: 时差, 时差反应. International travelers often suffer from jet lag. 国际旅行者经常遭受时差反应。 || 文化联想：从中国飞到美国后白天犯困、晚上睡不着，是 jet lag 最熟悉的场景，可以说 **jet lag — “A traveler flying from Beijing to California may struggle with jet lag for several days while the body clock adjusts.”**

quiz.question: flag ________
quiz.explanation: 减弱, 兴趣减弱. Audience attention began to flag interest halfway through the speech. 观众的注意力在演讲进行到一半时开始兴趣减弱。 || 文化联想：中文“三分钟热度”最适合帮助记忆 flag，可以说 **interest begins to flag — “Someone with ‘three-minute enthusiasm’ may start excitedly but soon find that interest begins to flag.”**

quiz.question: ________ slag
quiz.explanation: 熔渣, 冶炼熔渣. Industrial smelting slag must be disposed of properly. 工业冶炼熔渣必须妥善处理。 || 文化联想：炼铁炼钢后剩下的炉渣最适合帮助记忆 slag，可以说 **smelting slag — “After metal ore is smelted, a layer of smelting slag remains as waste separated from the molten metal.”**

quiz.question: rag ____
quiz.explanation: 破布, 布娃娃. The child clutched her beloved rag doll. 孩子紧紧抓着她心爱的布娃娃。 || 文化联想：旧社会孩子用碎布缝成布娃娃，是 rag 最直观的文化联想，可以说 **a rag doll — “A child in a poor household might once have played with a handmade rag doll stitched from leftover cloth.”**

quiz.question: brag _____
quiz.explanation: 吹嘘, 吹嘘关于. He would constantly brag about his accomplishments. 他会不断吹嘘自己的成就。 || 文化联想：中文“王婆卖瓜，自卖自夸”最适合帮助记忆 brag，可以说 **brag about oneself — “Like Wang Po praising her own melons, someone who constantly boasts may brag about himself at every opportunity.”**

quiz.question: _____ crag
quiz.explanation: 峭壁, 岩石峭壁. Eagles nest on the steep rocky crag. 鹰在陡峭的岩石峭壁上筑巢。 || 文化联想：黄山陡峭突出的岩峰最适合帮助记忆 crag，可以说 **a rocky crag — “A pine tree on Huangshan may cling to a narrow rocky crag high above the valley.”**

quiz.question: _____ tag
quiz.explanation: 标签, 价格标签. The price tag showed the item was on sale. 价格标签显示该商品正在促销。 || 文化联想：逛菜市场时每件商品前的小牌子会标价格，最适合帮助记忆 tag，可以说 **a price tag — “A shopper may check the price tag before deciding whether to buy a piece of clothing or household goods.”**

quiz.question: ___ rig
quiz.explanation: 钻井平台, 石油钻井平台. Workers on the offshore oil rig work in shifts. 海上石油钻井平台的工人轮班工作。 || 文化联想：大庆油田的钻井平台是中国人很容易联想到 rig 的工业形象，可以说 **an oil rig — “An oil rig in Daqing drills deep underground to reach petroleum-bearing rock.”**

quiz.question: ____-_________ prig
quiz.explanation: 自命清高的人, 自命清高的人. The self-righteous prig criticized everyone's behavior. 这个自命清高的人批评每个人的行为。 || 文化联想：中文“道貌岸然”最适合帮助记忆 prig，可以说 **a self-righteous prig — “Someone who constantly lectures others about morality while acting superior may come across as a self-righteous prig.”**

quiz.question: sprig __ ____
quiz.explanation: 小枝, 薄荷小枝. She garnished the drink with a fresh sprig of mint. 她用一枝新鲜的薄荷装饰饮料。 || 文化联想：端午节或夏日饮品里常放一小枝薄荷作点缀，最适合帮助记忆 sprig，可以说 **a sprig of mint — “A cool summer drink may be garnished with a fresh sprig of mint for fragrance and color.”**

quiz.question: ________ wig
quiz.explanation: 假发, 扑粉假发. Colonial gentlemen wore elegant powdered wig. 殖民时期的绅士戴着优雅的扑粉假发。 || 文化联想：京剧和戏曲人物造型常会使用假发片、髯口或头套，可以帮助记忆 wig，可以说 **a theatrical wig — “A Chinese opera performer may wear a theatrical wig or hairpiece to create the character’s stylized hairstyle.”**

quiz.question: bracing ___
quiz.explanation: 令人振奋的, 令人振奋的空气. The bracing air of the mountains invigorated the hikers. 山间令人振奋的空气使徒步旅行者精神焕发。 || 文化联想：东北冬天清晨冷冽清新的空气很适合联想到 bracing，可以说 **bracing winter air — “Stepping outside on a clear winter morning in Harbin, one immediately feels the bracing air on the face.”**

quiz.question: ____ icing
quiz.explanation: 糖霜, 蛋糕糖霜. The baker decorated the cake icing with intricate designs. 面包师用复杂的图案装饰蛋糕糖霜。 || 文化联想：中国生日蛋糕上抹奶油、写“生日快乐”最适合帮助记忆 icing，可以说 **cake icing — “A birthday cake may be covered with sweet icing and decorated with the Chinese characters for ‘Happy Birthday.’”**

quiz.question: entrancing ___________
quiz.explanation: 迷人的, 迷人的表演. The ballet dancer gave an entrancing performance. 芭蕾舞演员呈现了一场迷人的表演。 || 文化联想：川剧变脸往往让第一次观看的人看得入迷，最适合帮助记忆 entrancing，可以说 **an entrancing performance — “For a first-time viewer, rapid face-changing in Sichuan opera can be an entrancing performance that is hard to look away from.”**

quiz.question: ____ fencing
quiz.explanation: 击剑, 花剑击剑. She competed in foil fencing at the Olympics. 她在奥运会上参加了花剑击剑比赛。 || 文化联想：现代中国高校也有击剑社团，花剑训练最适合帮助记忆 fencing，可以说 **foil fencing — “A university fencing club may teach foil fencing, where students practice precise thrusts, footwork, and defensive parries.”**
